name: wstg-security-testing
description: Web application security testing using the OWASP Web Security Testing Guide (WSTG) methodology — 12 categories, ~109 canonical test cases. Four modes: guide an authorized pentest, self-review your own app, generate/score a coverage checklist, or review a code diff against relevant WSTG tests. Bundles the full test reference, detection payloads, a reporting template, and scripts to look up WSTG IDs and build/score checklists. Methodology from OWASP/wstg (https://github.com/OWASP/wstg). Authorized/defensive/educational use only.
